title: Pilot protocol adoption in one consumer repository
description: After the user selects a consumer, preserve its complete local rules as an overlay, render a self-contained AGENTS.md from a pinned agent-protocols commit, record any explicit exceptions, and prove a clean drift check. Do not select or mutate a consumer without user direction.

title: Separate unrelated general-purpose Codex skills
description: Decide a separate home for general-purpose skills such as ui, opinion, and readme. agent-protocols must retain only skills whose sole purpose is applying or auditing canonical protocols. Do not move personal skills until the user selects the destination and migration boundary.

title: Ship the v1 canonical protocol registry and drift checker
description: Contract: publish stable individually versioned protocol sources, four composable profiles (greenfield, fork, orchestrator, terminal-engine), a self-contained AGENTS.md renderer whose import record includes source commit and approved exceptions, structural drift detection, focused tests, and protocol-only Codex skills. Keep runtime dependencies at zero beyond Python 3 standard library. Rejected for v1: remote includes, semantic-compliance claims, a YAML dependency, hosted CI, and automatic edits to consumer repositories.
design: Canonical Markdown files own prose and metadata; a generated JSON index owns hashes; JSON profiles compose by ordered union. One Python 3 standard-library tool owns indexing, version-history enforcement, deterministic rendering, and structural drift checks. Consumer-local overlay and exception inputs remain separate from generated manifest and AGENTS.md. The source repo bootstraps its own hand-authored AGENTS.md because a self-pin would be recursive.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Exactly four requested profiles validate and can compose without duplicate protocol IDs. 2. Every imported protocol records ID, version, digest, source repository, and exact commit in the manifest and rendered AGENTS.md. 3. Local exceptions record protocol, scope, reason, approver, and date and are visible in AGENTS.md. 4. Drift in protocol sources, index, profile, overlay, exception input, manifest, generated AGENTS.md, or source checkout fails. 5. Protocol IDs cannot disappear and changed protocol files require higher versions. 6. Unit tests and both skill validators pass. 7. A clean committed checkout completes a public CLI render/check round trip.
notes: Dependency gate: selected Python 3 standard library over Rust (consumer toolchain/build burden), POSIX shell (fragile JSON/Unicode/error handling), and YAML/TOML parsers (new dependency or custom dialect). Exit cost is low because input/output schemas are plain Markdown and JSON. Hosted CI, remote includes, semantic compliance claims, and consumer mutations remain out of v1.
